{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of commas in revenue
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)

# Count how many have commas
n_with_commas = has_commas.sum()

# Extract the values with commas
comma_values = sales.loc[has_commas, 'revenue']

# Check if they are all '999,999.99' — the QA orders
is_all_999999 = (comma_values == '999,999.99').all()

print(f"Number of entries with commas: {n_with_commas}")
print(f"All are '999,999.99'? {is_all_999999}")

# Now, check if any non-QA orders have commas
non_qa_commas = sales.loc[(has_commas) & (sales['revenue'] != '999,999.99')]
print(f"Non-QA entries with commas: {len(non_qa_commas)}")"}
